dish.note: Hot puffs of fried yeast dough in honey syrup with cinnamon and walnuts.
dish.how: Mix 250g plain flour, 7g sachet dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt with 300ml warm water to a thick, sticky batter and rest in a warm spot for 45 minutes until bubbly. Simmer 150g honey with 100ml water and 1 tsp cinnamon for 5 minutes. Fry heaped teaspoons of batter in 180C oil for 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden, in 3 batches. Toss in the syrup and top with 60g chopped walnuts.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water to a thick batter.
Rest in a warm spot until bubbly.
Simmer the honey, water and cinnamon into a syrup.
Fry spoonfuls of batter in 180C oil, turning, in 3 batches.
Toss in the syrup and top with chopped walnuts.

dish.make_ahead: Best fried just before serving; syrup keeps for 3 days
